pkg.description: {@link Pkg} in which the {@link TestSuite} should be produced.

failIfUnsupported.description: If true, throw an error if the language is unsupported.

emptyFile.description: If true, return an empty file if there are no test cases

className.description: Test class name, if not extracted from the source file name.

fastCalls.description:
Prefer most direct calling path to dispatching. This is mostly for Java; specifying this will use the
code-generated interface, even for generated types.

ignoreGlobals.description:
Skip validation of unknown global variables. This is useful for display, but may lead to the generation of
incorrect code.
